experiment_template.research_question: Can complete terminal feedback remove the measurement failure within the original budget?

falsifier: Correction fails to produce a valid source-bound terminal selection, exceeds original budgets, changes source through tools, or introduces invented evidence.
mechanism: Return all bounded parse/schema/reference defects and permit one tools-disabled correction within the same remaining call and model-token budgets.
scope: Shared instrument repair for both arms in ContextBench development round two. Not proof of retention or repaired task correctness.
statement: Complete terminal-envelope diagnostics allow measurable final context without free calls or silently accepting malformed output.
